"BORING SIMPLE STRENGTH"
Bill Starr Tribute
Day: 15 Tuesday 10-15-24

Warm Up: Take a couple minutes and learn about Bill Starr. 5 x 5

1. BACK SQUAT
5 reps @ 67%, 70%, 73%, 75%, 77%
2 to 2½ min rest between sets

2. BENCH PRESS 5 sets of 5 reps
same %'s as the above squats
same rest

3. BB BENT OVER Rows 5 sets of 5 reps
2 min rest

Cardio
DB RDL's
5 sets of 5 reps
2 min rest between sets

Recovery
Chicken Casserole extra helping
30 min Walk
8-9 hrs Sleep
